summary: Iteration 4 covers the 3 new features requested: Badge Creator, Family Calendar, and Team Missions — plus regression from previous iterations. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py by 3 new test classes (TestBadges, TestEvents, TestTeamMissions) — 9 new tests. All 46/46 pytest tests pass in 13.4s (parallel-safe). New coverage: seed badges (>=3), badge CRUD + award flow (points_reward added to member, award_count reflected in list, my-badges endpoint returns the badge for the awardee), double-award blocked with 400, badge admin-only guard (403); seed events (>=3), event create with bonus_points_day, member GET events succeeds, member POST/DELETE events blocked (403), admin delete works; seed team mission (>=1), <2 participant create returns 400, full flow: create with 3 participants -> each of Garralt/Willow/Avery calls /contribute -> status flips to pending_approval -> admin /approve splits points_reward // participant_count evenly (verified 90//3 = 30 each) and marks completed -> subsequent /contribute returns 400 (not active), admin-only create (403). Frontend Playwright (public URL, viewport 1920x900): Admin login -> Badge Creator (nav-badge-creator) -> created UI_TEST Badge (add-badge-btn, badge-name, badge-points=3, save-badge-btn), medal card visible with tier pill + award count; awarded to Avery (award-badge-<id> -> award-to-<Avery.id>); attempted double-award immediately returned 400 (visible as failed request in console). Calendar (nav-calendar) -> Admin created UI_TEST Event dated 2030-12-25 (add-event-btn, event-title, event-date, save-event-btn), visible under Upcoming. Team Missions (nav-team-missions) -> Admin add-team-mission-btn -> team-title=UI_TEST Team Mission, team-points=60, no participants -> Save shows validation toast (frontend: 'Pick at least 2 members'), then picked Garralt + Willow via team-member-<id> and save-team-mission-btn created it. Willow (PIN 5678) logged in: /app/calendar shows event but add-event-btn absent (read-only ✔) and UI_TEST Event visible; Team Missions shows contribute-team-<id> which incremented progress. Garralt (PIN 1234) logged in and also contributed. Admin logged back in and clicked approve-team-<id>: toast 'Approved! Rewards split among the team' — status card flipped to Completed, and via /api/users Garralt went 1377->1407 (+30), Willow 760->790 (+30), matching 60//2=30. Achievements page: Willow's my-badge-<id> section rendered with 1 seeded 'Household Legend' badge (Willow did not receive UI_TEST). Cleanup: UI_TEST Badge, UI_TEST Event, UI_TEST Team Mission all deleted via API. Regression: admin login + Command Center, member PIN login (no onboarding), and previous 37 tests all still pass — sidebar contains Team Missions, Badge Creator, Calendar entries in the correct nav-* form.

issues: Radix DialogContent likely still missing aria-describedby / DialogDescription — same a11y console warning noted in iteration 3. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1663 lines (from 1455). Continue to be worth splitting into routers per domain (auth, users, chores, assignments, transfers, rules, challenges, rewards, badges, events, team_missions, reports, security, settings, dashboard).
GET /api/badges runs N+1 count_documents on badge_awards (one query per badge inside the loop). Prefer a single aggregation with $group on badge_awards to fetch counts in one round-trip.

POST /api/badges/{bid}/award increments points_balance and lifetime_points but does not enforce point_reward>=0 in BadgeCreate (Field(ge=0) missing). A negative point_reward would silently subtract points on award.
POST /api/events/{eid} accepts arbitrary date string (str); no ISO-date validation. A malformed date will silently be stored and sorted lexicographically, which will break the calendar order.
TeamMissionCreate.participant_ids has no dedup — passing [id1, id1, id2] would let the same member 'mark done' twice and inflate progress/participant_count. Consider set()-ing it server-side.

team_mission approve uses integer division (points_reward // participants); remainder is silently discarded (e.g., 100 pts / 3 = 33 each, 1 pt lost). Consider distributing the remainder or documenting the rule.
contribute endpoint does not prevent re-marking done by the same user (idempotent, but no observable difference). Consider returning 400 if already done to give clearer UX.
Frontend BadgeManager & TeamMissions use window.confirm for delete (BadgeManager) — inconsistent with the rest of the app which prefers shadcn AlertDialog.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of Badge Creator + Family Calendar + Team Missions flows verified end-to-end
